info.description: API documentation for the Common Entities service
info.title: Common Entities service

get.summary: Retrieves a list of existing entities
get.description: Use this operation to return a list of entities with all its attributes. Warning: This API call may return large set of records, depending on your filter settings
get.operationId: Retrieves a list of existing entities

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The page of data to return (0 = first page).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of entities per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort string of the form [+/-]?{fieldName}

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: This returns all the attributes for a given Entity.

parameters.name: include_disabled
parameters.description: This is to return DISABLED entities along with ACTIVE entities.

post.description: Use this operation to create a new entity with its attributes

requestBody.description: The details about the entities that will be added.

patch.summary: Updates a list of existing entities
patch.description: Use this operation to partially update attributes for a given list of entities. This operation can be used to associate a list of entities with ONESOURCE applications to leverage the same entities across various applications
patch.operationId: Updates a list of existing entities

requestBody.description: The input object for performing bulk update.

parameters.name: versionId
parameters.description: The version ID that will be filtered.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: This returns all the attributes for a given Entity.

put.description: Use this operation to update an existing entity version with its attributes. Enter the version Id in the URL

parameters.name: versionId
parameters.description: The Version attributes that will be modified

requestBody.description: The details about the version attributes will be updated.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: The entity ID that will be filtered.

parameters.description: The Entity instance that will be modified

requestBody.description: Pass ACTIVE/DISABLED as status below to update entity's status.

delete.description: Use this operation to soft delete an existing entity with all its attributes and versions. Enter the entity Id in the URL. Warning: Though this operation is soft delete, we currently do not support the “Undo” API to recover the deleted entity

parameters.description: The Entity ID associated to all other versions that will be deleted.
